message.subject: Exploratory collaboration with EDXSO
message.email_body: Creating engaging animations often demands hours of learning complex software, which holds many educators back from visual teaching. Your video on making stickman videos with free AI caught our attention as a great solution to this. At EDXSO, we are planning an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed, to help them adopt practical technology in schools. We invite you to reply if a short call this month would suit you.
